name: praise-layout
description: PraiseLayout MVP prototype for A3 worship sheet layout generation.

scripts.app:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.app:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy
scripts.app:run:ios: npm run build && npx cap run ios
scripts.app:build:ios: npm run app:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData build
